newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Materials sees 1997 sales growth.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Materials sees 1997 sales growth.

text.p: Advanced Materials Group said Wednesday it expects sales growth of 45-50 percent in fiscal 1997, based on existing program orders and commitments.
Earlier in the year the company forecast 1997 sales growth of 35-40 percent.

Advanced Materials today reported earnings for the second quarter, ended June 1, of $665,000, or $0.06 per share, down from $2,543,000, or $0.24 a share, a year ago. Sales rose to $7,068,000 from $3,854,000.

The company said that based on historical cycles, it could see a slight seasonal slowing in the third quarter as customers adjust inventory levels, but it expects an acceleration of orders in the fourth quarter.
The company said it is in the process of formulating plans to expand into the Pacific Rim and UK in response to requests from some major customers in Europe and Asia.
